probes.label: random-out-of-order-partial-keeps-array-order
probes.php: every one of 200 draws of Arr::random([2 => 'c', 0 => 'a', 1 => 'b'], 2, true) lists its keys in the array's own order

probes.label: random-mixed-partial-keeps-array-order
probes.php: every one of 200 draws of Arr::random(['x' => 1, 0 => 2, 'y' => 3], 2) lists its values in the array's own order

probes.label: random-out-of-order-partial-values-keep-array-order
probes.php: every one of 200 draws of Arr::random([2 => 'c', 0 => 'a', 1 => 'b'], 2) lists two values in the array's own order

probes.label: random-list-partial-keeps-array-order
probes.php: every one of 200 draws of Arr::random(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'], 2) lists its values in the array's own order

probes.label: sole-out-of-order-first-call-only
probes.php: Arr::sole([2 => 'c', 0 => 'a', 1 => 'b'], a callback true only on its first call)

probes.label: every-numeric-string-keys-callback-order
probes.php: Arr::every(['2' => 'c', '0' => 'a'], fn ($v, $k) => true) => keys seen, with deprecations

probes.label: every-true-key-callback-order
probes.php: Arr::every([true => 'a'], fn ($v, $k) => true) => keys seen, with deprecations

probes.label: every-null-key-callback-order
probes.php: Arr::every([null => 'a'], fn ($v, $k) => true) => keys seen, with deprecations

deprecations: Using null as an array offset is deprecated, use an empty string instead

probes.label: every-float-key-callback-order
probes.php: Arr::every([1.5 => 'a'], fn ($v, $k) => true) => keys seen, with deprecations

deprecations: Implicit conversion from float 1.5 to int loses precision
